judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

C.V. Karthikeyan, J.:— The petitioner has filed the present Writ Petition for issuance of a Writ of certiorarified Mandamus, to call for all the records relating to the impugned order circular No. P(s)171/OBC/Federation dated 17.04.2018 issued by the Chief Personnel Manager, Southern Railway, the first respondent herein, and quash the same and consequently direct the first, second and third respondents herein to cooperate and nominate responsible officers to oversee the elections by secret ballot to be conducted to the posts of President and General Secretary of the petitioner Association as requested by the petitioner Association in their representation dated 05.06.2018.

2. Mr. Ram Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the respondents would submit that that the writ petition has been filed challenging the circular dated 17.04.2018, wherein, the names of the President and General Secretary nomination list was published. In the very same circular, it is stated as follows:

“The above mentioned persons will continue in these posts till further orders or a newly legally valid body is elected and assumes the charges, whichever is earlier, as mentioned in the letter referred above.”

3. Subsequently, on 30.18.2018 the list of Office Bearers of the Zonal Executive Committee was published by the Southern Railway.

4. In view of the same, the Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous. No costs. Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
